# Enargeia

> A browser-native LLM inference engine. Hand-written WGSL compute kernels, int4 block-wise
> quantized weights, no ML framework. Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct runs entirely on the visitor's GPU.

Measured on an Apple M2, headless Chromium: decode 45.5 tok/s at a 512-token context and
43.1 at 2048, prefill 1105 tok/s at 128 tokens, 334.9 MiB of weights resident against
1884.6 MiB for the same model in fp32. Perplexity 36.21 against 31.90 in fp32 over 1,256
held-out positions. No inference happens on a server.
